name: @agentbbs/data-access
//sideEffects: The package has NO module-load side effects (every module only DEFINES functions/constants/types; nothing runs at import). Declaring it side-effect-free lets bundlers (esbuild, for the VS Code extension) TREE-SHAKE the unused better-sqlite3 path when a consumer imports only the node:sqlite adapter — so `require('better-sqlite3')` never lands in the extension-host bundle (where the native addon is absent). Story 10.2.
